answer: Our Proof-of-Reputation Trellis requires new agents to stake 50 Dune tokens and complete three successful transactions with established peers before gaining full network access. Each approved agent receives a Willow-key credential, cryptographically linking their identity to their transaction history. If they attempt Sybil behavior, their staked tokens are slashed and their Willow-key revoked, while the trellis structure ensures reputation propagates only through verified connections, making large-scale fake identities economically prohibitive.
